justification: Documentation only. Seven markdown sources plus a README added under docs/pitch/, and one whitelist entry in .gitignore so they are trackable at all. No code path, no served output, no database access, no dependency change.

pre_impl.skipped: Minor tier — no data, schema or state interaction.

break_it.scenario: A reader trusts a PR number in docs/pitch/cheat-sheet.md and opens it to find something unrelated.
break_it.what_happens: The pitch's whole subject is verifying claims, so one wrong citation discredits the rest of it.
break_it.how: docs/pitch/cheat-sheet.md — every PR link re-verified against origin/main on 2026-08-10. Rows 4 and 6 cited #835, which contains neither script; corrected to #363 and #347. Recorded in the file's own verification note.

break_it.scenario: The generated .docx a buyer receives drifts from the markdown committed here, so the repo and the buyer disagree.
break_it.what_happens: A correction lands in git and never reaches anyone, which is the failure that made this PR necessary.
break_it.how: docs/pitch/README.md carries the exact pandoc regeneration commands, and states the markdown is the source and the binaries are rebuildable.

break_it.scenario: docs/pitch/ is added but stays untracked because docs/* is ignored, so the source is lost again.
break_it.what_happens: Silent — git add appears to work and the files never reach the remote.
break_it.how: .gitignore whitelist entries !docs/pitch/ and !docs/pitch/**; confirmed with git ls-files --error-unmatch docs/pitch/cheat-sheet.md before commit.

post_merge.db_reset: None. No database access anywhere in the diff.
post_merge.secrets: None. No credential, token or environment variable is read or written.
post_merge.other_repo: None. The generated docx/html/pdf live outside git in pitch-package/; they rebuild from these sources and nothing consumes them programmatically.
post_merge.manual_verify: Optional: regenerate the buyer-facing docx/pdf from these sources using the pandoc commands in docs/pitch/README.md, so the pack a buyer receives matches the corrected markdown.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: The docs/pitch whitelist entry is removed or misspelled, so the sources silently stop being tracked and this exits non-zero.
